## What changed

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior.

## Try it

A link or steps a reviewer can follow to see the change: the Vercel preview
(a maintainer authorizes it for pull requests from forks), or steps to run it
locally, for example `pnpm dev:local`, then open a page and click something.
Name any key it needs beyond `dev:local`.

## Validation

List the relevant checks and their results. Include screenshots for visual
changes. Say which browser you tried it in, or that you didn't.

## Configuration or migrations

Note any required setup, data changes, or rollout steps. Do not include
credentials.
